title: Special Olympics Brand Identity Guidelines
slide_intent: Introduce the organization through an athlete in action so the reader meets the subject of the identity before learning its specifications.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can connect its name and symbol to an athletic event from the reader’s first encounter with the book.
demonstration: A race photograph fills the cover above an arc. A runner in a red Monaco jersey leads the group pictured, with the white book title across the foreground and a separate mark in the white lower field.
practical_value: Use a photograph with a clear focal athlete and choose a region for the title where the action remains readable.

content_islands.name: Race photograph
content_islands.spec: Run the image across the cover, favoring the central runner, and carry a red treatment toward the edges.

content_islands.name: Book title and resource
content_islands.spec: Place the resource address at upper left and the large two-line title over the lower portion of the image.

content_islands.name: Identification footer
content_islands.spec: Cut a curved white field below the photograph. Place the version at left and the lockup at right.
